heroHeadline: Ankara Court Annuls CHP Leadership, Sparks Mass Protests and International Backlash
heroSubtitle: The 36th Ankara Regional Court of Appeal on May 21, 2026 annulled the CHP's entire party leadership and reinstated former chair Kılıçdaroğlu — triggering a 6%+ BIST-100 drop and protests across Turkey's major cities. The EU, US, Council of Europe, and Human Rights Watch condemned the ruling as an attack on democratic opposition. Istanbul Mayor İmamoğlu remains jailed with his trial expanding, while the Kurdish peace process is stalled over Öcalan's status. Turkey's lira hit record lows past 45.5/USD as April inflation came in above consensus at 32.37%. Turkey simultaneously hosts preparation for the July 2026 NATO Summit in Ankara and the EFES-2026 military exercise concluded with Syria and Libya joining for historic firsts.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets (Reuters, BBC, Bloomberg, Al Jazeera, Euronews, Defense News, Turkish Minute, Daily Sabah), institutional analyses (HRW, ICG, Freedom House), and US State Department readouts.
